scope: Nine exact tedy/teda sites functioning as the logical apodosis in an ako...to conditional construction.
choice: Replace only those selected ordinals with to, yielding branch-neutral ako...to; do not introduce temporal togda.
motivation: German and mathematical clause structure show premise-to-consequence conditionals, never event-time sequence. The official grammar already establishes ako...to.
alternatives_rejected: Togda would falsely temporalize logical conditionals.
Zato would overstate the apodotic particle as a standalone conclusion adverb.
Blanket tedy/teda replacement would corrupt adjacent non-apodotic tokens on mixed lines.

evidence.semantic_review: Eight Book 44 sites and one base-text site were aligned to German wenn/ist...also...so and inspected in full sentence context.
evidence.global_temporal_result: The complete audited tedy/teda family contains zero genuine temporal-event uses.

validation.guards: all adjacent same-line non-apodotic tedy/teda tokens unchanged
validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/refs/cites, braces, math delimiters and line counts invariant
validation.reproducibility: frozen successor hashes reproduced before atomic apply
